subject: Mathematics

source.name: CISCE Curriculum for Classes I-V (Mathematics), Primary

notes: CISCE primary Maths is strand-organized; strand names as chapters, key concepts as subtopics. Fetched via Web Archive snapshot of the official cisce.org PrimaryCurriculum.pdf (live link 404s).

chapters.name: Numbers
subtopics: Introduction to zero via a subtraction pattern
Counting 1 to 99 by groups of tens and ones
Numerals/number names up to 99 and comparison
Forming two-digit numbers from given digits

chapters.name: Number Operations
subtopics: Addition and subtraction within 99 without regrouping
Problems from pictures and verbal descriptions

chapters.name: Geometry
subtopics: 2D shapes: rectangle, square, triangle, circle, line

chapters.name: Patterns
subtopics: Simple patterns in shapes and numbers
